findings.session_summary: Initial session focused on establishing a practical, non-judgmental approach to a learning access barrier (seating visibility). The mentor and student identified the main obstacle as the inability to see the board from the current seat, leading to copying errors. They agreed on a small, realistic between-session task: noting one lesson where the obstacle occurs. No external services were delivered or approved; only the mentoring session itself occurred.
findings.primary_concern: Learning access barrier due to seating position preventing visibility of the board.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Student will note one lesson where the seating obstacle occurs, provided it fits their schedule.
Student expressed uncertainty about whether seats can be changed and requested checking school policy/contacts before promising support.
Student noted that dealing with the issue alone was ineffective, but asking a classmate provided partial utility.

next_steps: Check school policy or contact relevant staff regarding seat change eligibility.
Student to attempt the agreed small step (noting one lesson) if schedule permits.
uncertainties: Whether a seat change is possible or approved.
Exact dates and confirmation of service availability remain uncertain.
findings.conclusion: The initial session successfully identified the main barrier (seating visibility) and established a cautious, practical approach. The intended intervention involves checking school policy for seat changes, but no external support has been delivered yet. The student agreed to a small monitoring task. Evidence supports that the session was helpful in clarifying steps, but improvement in the barrier or attendance cannot be confirmed as this is the first session and no external aid has been received.

findings.session_summary: Follow-up session focused on reviewing the previous plan regarding seating visibility and attempting a practical activity (comparing worksheet layouts). The student reported partial completion of the between-session task due to scheduling constraints. A new in-session activity was attempted but remains unverified for future use. The core uncertainty regarding seat change eligibility persists.
